name: Brief the next meeting
description: Check the calendar for meetings starting inside the lead time and send a brief for any that has not had one. Follow the stored procedures 'Which meetings get a brief' — applied first — and 'How to write a meeting brief'. Read the installation settings with WorkflowManager_get_installation_params(slug='meeting_prep') and honour 'lead_minutes', 'skip_recurring' and 'focus'. Use the brief_window function for the send time and the history window to search. Combine back-to-backs into one message before the first, and never brief the same meeting twice.
